name: ES-CL Intraday Correlation: US/EU Overlap
description: Rolling 60-bar correlation between ES and CL 5-min returns during the US/EU session overlap (8:00-11:30 AM ET). Measures real-time co-movement between equities and crude oil during the most liquid cross-asset window. Outputs: correlation time series with 20-bar smoothed overlay, histogram of session-end readings, and summary statistics.
source:
# ES-CL Intraday Correlation: US/EU Overlap Window
# Rolling 60-bar correlation of 5-min returns during 8:00-11:30 AM ET
# ES = primary asset, CL = reference futures

# --- Data: ES (primary) ---
es_raw = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es_cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=5Min, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(es_raw.o, es_raw.h, es_raw.l, es_raw.c, es_raw.v, es_raw.oi, es_raw.s)

# --- Data: CL (reference) ---
cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=5Min, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# --- Session: US/EU overlap 8:00-11:30 AM ET ---
overlap = session_window(session=Session(start='08:00', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York'))(es_cont.o, es_cont.h, es_cont.l, es_cont.c)

# --- Returns: 5-min bar-to-bar % change ---
es_ret = returns(period=1)(es_cont.c)
cl_ret = returns(period=1)(ffill(cl_cont.c))

# --- Rolling correlation (60-bar window) ---
corr_60 = rolling_corr(window=60)(es_ret, cl_ret)

# --- Filter to overlap session only ---
# Intra-session: show correlation while session is active
corr_in_session = where(overlap.active, corr_60)

# Session-end snapshot: one reading per day (sparse — for stats/histogram)
corr_eod = where(overlap.closed, corr_60)

# Smoothed overlay: 20-bar MA of the in-session correlation
corr_smooth = where(overlap.active, ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(corr_60))

# --- Decorrelation events: session-end correlation below -0.5 ---
is_decorrelation = is_valid(corr_eod) and corr_eod < -0.5

# --- Timestamps for x-axis ---
ts = index()

# --- Output 1: Correlation time series (ffill for rendering, per S48) ---
xy_lines(
    title='ES-CL Rolling Correlation During US/EU Overlap',
    category='ES-CL Overlap Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Bar Corr', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Bar Smoothed', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Decorrelation')
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_in_session, corr_smooth))

# --- Output 2: Histogram of session-end correlation readings (sparse, per S48) ---
histogram(
    title='How Correlated Are ES and CL During the Overlap?',
    category='ES-CL Overlap Correlation',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_label='Session-End Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(corr_eod)

# --- Output 3: Summary stats table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Session-End Correlation Stats',
        row_size=3, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Central Tendency', 'Extremes', 'Regime'],
        col_headers=['Metric', 'Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Total session-end observations'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Median session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Worst (most negative) session-end reading'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Best (most positive) session-end reading'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Mean session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Std dev of session-end readings')
        ]
    ),
    category='ES-CL Overlap Correlation',
    order=3
)(corr_eod, corr_eod, corr_eod, corr_eod, corr_eod, corr_eod)

# --- Event markers: decorrelation episodes ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='ES-CL Decorrelation',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='ES Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(corr_eod, es_cont.c, cl_cont.c, is_decorrelation)
